title: CollabShell 2.2.0
release_notes:
- Upgraded to Flet 1.0: snappier copy/open buttons (client-side actions), a biometric check before clearing your Google credentials, and more reliable platform storage
- New: High-RAM machine shape when creating sessions (CPU/T4/G4/A100/H100), shown as a badge on session cards
- New: environment variables (KEY=VALUE) injected before every code run — Settings → Execution
- New: tap Compute Usage in Settings → About for your compute-unit balance, burn rate, and active runtimes
- Notebook cells now render Markdown and HTML outputs (pandas DataFrames, rich reprs) instead of dropping them
- Drive mount credentials propagate reliably again, and quota/capacity errors show a friendly message instead of a traceback
- Fixed two crash-on-import bugs, a UI freeze when opening a terminal, and session cleanup when closing the app
- Settings now save instantly (native storage) with your existing preferences imported automatically
